name: @pipeworx/mcp-eol

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search EOL for a name (common or scientific).

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Fetch a taxon page by EOL id (synonyms, common names, hierarchy summary).

detail.description: Include data objects (texts, images). Default false.

tools.name: pages_by_name
tools.description: Find EOL page id(s) for an exact scientific name.

tools.name: hierarchy
tools.description: Taxonomic hierarchy for a given EOL hierarchy entry id (from get_page).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-eol forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the eol pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
